description: Eastern Province - Notifying that the Eastern Province Supplementary Estimate Statute No. 01 of 2015 and No. 02 of 2015 were passed by the Council
reasoning: This gazette content announces the passing and assent of provincial supplementary estimate statutes (No. 01 and 02 of 2015) by the Eastern Province Provincial Council. This constitutes legal/regulatory matter as it involves the enactment of statutory instruments (provincial statutes) rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
